verdict.rationale: Accounts payable is a fair question for a travel-and-expense and spend-management platform like Navan, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers expense management, reimbursements, receipt scanning, card transactions and policy/approval workflows for expenses. Nothing documents invoice capture, bill approval routing, or paying vendors by ACH, check, or wire, and expense approvals and receipt scanning are adjacent features rather than AP.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire
